title: Third-party scorer egress kwargs rejection must stay unconditional, independent of MLFLOW_SERVER_ENABLE_CUSTOM_SCORERS
answers: third-party scorer kwargs api_base SSRF on the server
judge custom endpoint api_base or base_url rejected with 400 on scorer register or invoke
completion_kwargs base_url blocked in a trulens scorer payload
body:
Invariant: Third-party scorer kwargs that steer the judge's outbound requests (api_base, base_url, completion_kwargs and similar) are always rejected on register, invoke, stored-scorer reads and genai evaluate, including inside ensemble sub-scorers (any depth) and MemAlign base_judge.
Enforced by: mlflow/utils/validation.py:_validate_third_party_scorer_data, which walks every third_party_scorer_data via _iter_third_party_scorer_data and finds keys via _find_destination_keys; called from mlflow/server/handlers.py:_validate_serialized_scorer_payload.
What breaks if skipped: Unauthenticated SSRF (GHSA-2wqp-q3c6-ccj5, CWE-918/470) where attacker-controlled api_base or completion_kwargs redirect the server's litellm calls.
Constraints: Do not wire MLFLOW_SERVER_ENABLE_CUSTOM_SCORERS or any other operator opt-in into this validator. The flag only governs the call_source exec() guard in mlflow/genai/scorers/scorer_utils.py:custom_scorer_execution_blocked. Existing rejection tests in tests/server/test_handlers.py must keep passing unchanged.
Constraints: kwargs must be a JSON object or null; any other shape is a 400. A list of two-item pairs is also a key carrier because dict() accepts it, so pair lists in nested options are scanned as well.
Applies: Any change to scorer payload validation or to the server's scorer judge configuration on the handler side.

search: Third-party scorer kwargs steering outbound judge requests (such as api_base, base_url, and completion_kwargs) must be unconditionally rejected on registration, invocation, reads, and evaluation to prevent unauthenticated SSRF. Payload validation in mlflow/utils/validation.py scans kwargs at any depth, including ensemble sub-scorers and MemAlign base_judge, and rejects non-object or non-null shapes with a 400 status. This rejection must remain independent of MLFLOW_SERVER_ENABLE_CUSTOM_SCORERS, which only controls the exec() guard in mlflow/genai/scorers/scorer_utils.py.
